newsitem.title: USA: Electricity still out in parts of Cape Cod.
newsitem.headline: Electricity still out in parts of Cape Cod.

text.p: More than 10,000 homes and businesses were still without power on Tuesday on Cape Cod and Martha's Vineyard after Hurricane Edouard swept past on Monday, Commonwealth Electric said.

"As of 4:30 p.m., we had more than 10,000 people without electricity," said Cindy Angus, a spokeswoman for Commonwealth Electric, a unit of Commonwealth Energy System. "Our restoration effort is going to start to slow down and it's not likely that everybody is going to be restored today."
Many of the 66 crews that worked to restore electricity on Tuesday needed a break after working long hours, she said.
